_note: Committed baseline for the regression gate: a run whose micro_f1 falls more
than PII_MAX_F1_DROP (default 0.02) below this value fails the gate.
Only micro_f1 and dataset_sha256 are read. Machine-specific paths and the
per-category breakdown are deliberately left out -- the breakdown belongs to
each run's own report under tests/quality/reports/ (gitignored).
Regenerate: pytest -m quality, then copy micro_f1 and dataset_sha256 out of
the fresh result.json. The comparison only means something when
dataset_sha256 matches -- across different datasets the numbers are not
comparable, which is why require_same_dataset defaults to on.
